# Concept coverage

<!-- written by `mesh.py build`; do not edit by hand -->

Every concept is to be meshed across every source and every indexed abstract. A source is meshed for a concept when each passage naming it is covered by one of its cards or settled by a `decided::` line in its scan file (`mesh.py scan <concept>`); an indexed abstract when its `concepts::` line links the concept or a `concept_decided::` line settles it (`mesh.py scan --abstracts`). Matching is by the concept's names and aliases. Low-priority concepts need nothing.
